assets.crate:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one isolated transparent 2D game sprite for an orthogonal tilemap
Input image: style reference only; do not reproduce the whole map.
Primary request: a golden wooden crate, broad square top with an inset X brace, short vertical front face, like the crates in the reference. Compact, low height. No floor or shadow extending beyond the object.
Style: polished cheerful miniature toy game art matching the reference, saturated colors, softly shaded chunky shapes, clean defined edges.
Camera: fixed front-facing orthographic three-quarter overhead view, see the top and front; grid sides parallel with the image axes, no diamond isometric grid, no vanishing point, no perspective shrink.
Composition: ONE complete object centered in the image with generous transparent margins; show the entire silhouette, bottom centered ground-contact point; don't crop or place neighbors.
Lighting: gentle upper-left light, darker front faces, consistent with the reference.
Constraints: genuine transparent background, no checkerboard painted into the image, no floor, no scene, no text, no labels, no frame, no watermark.
